question: What is the percentage of male clients among all clients residing in the top five districts (ranked by number of female account holders) that have recorded at least one credit card withdrawal after 1995?

prediction.sql:
WITH female_account_holders AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_002 AS district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) AS female_account_count
    FROM client c
    INNER JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    GROUP BY a.XCL_002
),
top_five_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM female_account_holders
    ORDER BY female_account_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
districts_with_cc_withdrawal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002 AS district_id
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
    INNER JOIN card c ON d.XCL_013 = c.XCL_006
    INNER JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
    WHERE t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) > '1995'
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(c.XCL_010 = 'M') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.XCL_009)
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
WHERE d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT tf.district_id
    FROM top_five_districts tf
    WHERE tf.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM districts_with_cc_withdrawal)
)

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH female_account_holders AS (
    SELECT a.XCL_002 AS district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_001) AS female_account_count
    FROM client c
    INNER JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    GROUP BY a.XCL_002
),
top_five_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM female_account_holders
    ORDER BY female_account_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
districts_with_cc_withdrawal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002 AS district_id
    FROM account a
    INNER JOIN disp d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
    INNER JOIN card c ON d.XCL_013 = c.XCL_006
    INNER JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
    WHERE t.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', t.XCL_048) > '1995'
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(c.XCL_010 = 'M') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.XCL_009)
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
WHERE d.XCL_017 IN (
    SELECT tf.district_id
    FROM top_five_districts tf
    WHERE tf.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM districts_with_cc_withdrawal)
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH female_districts AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_017, COUNT(c.XCL_009) AS female_count
    FROM client c
    INNER JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    GROUP BY d.XCL_017
    ORDER BY female_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
valid_districts AS (
    SELECT fd.XCL_017
    FROM female_districts fd
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM card card
        INNER JOIN disp d ON card.XCL_006 = d.XCL_013
        INNER JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
        INNER JOIN district dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
        WHERE dist.XCL_017 = fd.XCL_017
          AND card.XCL_008 > '1995-12-31'
    )
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(c.XCL_010 = 'M') AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.XCL_009)
FROM client c
INNER JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
WHERE d.XCL_017 IN (SELECT XCL_017 FROM valid_districts)
